description: This Java source file defines the class 'SagePayPaymentServices', which provides various payment processing services such as authorization, capture, refund, void, and release for SagePay integration within the OFBiz framework. It handles building billing information, invoking external payment services, and processing responses.

classes.name: SagePayPaymentServices
classes.description: A service class providing methods for SagePay payment transactions, including authorization, capture, refund, void, and release, with internal helper methods for building billing info and processing responses.

methods.name: buildCustomerBillingInfo
methods.description: Constructs a map containing billing and credit card information from the transaction context, used for payment requests.

methods.name: ccAuth
methods.description: Handles credit card authentication requests by initiating the authorization process with SagePay.

methods.name: processCardAuthorisationPayment
methods.description: Internal method that performs the actual authorization call to SagePay and processes the response.

methods.name: ccCapture
methods.description: Handles capturing of authorized credit card payments.

methods.name: processCardCapturePayment
methods.description: Internal method that performs capture transaction with SagePay.

methods.name: ccRefund
methods.description: Handles refund requests of captured payments.

methods.name: processCardRefundPayment
methods.description: Internal method executing the refund transaction with SagePay.

methods.name: processCardVoidPayment
methods.description: Executes void transaction for a captured payment.

methods.name: ccRelease
methods.description: Handles the release of authorization holds (release payment).

methods.name: processCardReleasePayment
methods.description: Internal method that calls SagePay to release the transaction hold.
